triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var caster = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!caster) return false; var trigger = ctx.sourcePiece; if (!trigger) return false; return trigger.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId; }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var caster = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!caster) return { success: false, message: '' }; var trigger = ctx.sourcePiece; if (!trigger) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (trigger.ownerPlayerId === caster.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0 && Math.max(Math.abs(p.x - caster.x), Math.abs(p.y - caster.y)) <= 2; }); if (enemies.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var target = enemies[Math.floor(Math.random() * enemies.length)]; var result = dealDamage(caster, target, caster.attack, 'physical', battle, 'pulse-pistol'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的脉冲手枪触发，对' + target.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点伤害' }; }
